title: GZCoord tool dictionary
description: The complete key -> string dictionary for one active locale of the GZCoord tools — every line the inbox prints around a message, never the message itself. The house i18n shape (gzapp ADR-024 §2.4, contracts/i18n/i18n.schema.json): one flat dictionary per locale, keys as dotted slugs, values non-empty, `{name}` interpolation. Completeness against en-US.json is enforced by tools/fabric/lint.py before a dictionary lands; at runtime a key the dictionary lacks falls back to en-US rather than failing a session start, and nothing is ever fabricated.

propertyNames.description: A flat dotted slug, <area>.<thing>: lower-case, kebab inside a segment.

additionalProperties.description: The translated line. Non-empty; an empty string is not a localization value.
